findings.note: Covers (Joe Osborne) picks Strange anytime TD with Jaguars -9.5, not a receptions pick; says Strange has seen 7+ targets in 3 of his last 4 games, is JAX's #2 target, and Baltimore has given up six TDs to tight ends.

Undated blurb says Washington (12) and Thomas (8) took 20 of Lawrence's 29 targets in one game, leaving little for Strange, who still ran 25 routes on 31 dropbacks. Page shows 28 catches this season, about 4 per game across 7 games, right at the line.

Bucky Brooks says a short-handed Ravens team (Fagnano at QB) is in trouble and that JAX targets are spread over Washington, Meyers, Thomas and Strange. He describes a strong run game, which together with a big spread points to a lopsided game where JAX could pass less.
